prompt_set_summary: Six original transparent three-quarter isometric Border Oath landmark source masters, one for every playable faction. The set deliberately uses six different physical structures rather than recolors: charter hardware, hooked reed drums, prism geometry, living roots, pressure machinery, and ship-rib chains. Each silhouette remains identifiable in a compact 48-pixel cell. Prompts exclude scenery, ground tiles, frames, labels, logos, copied heraldry, copyrighted assets, and protected visual expression.
